product.name: Daily Health Monitoring for Chronic Conditions
product.description: A remote patient monitoring service that tracks vital signs and symptoms daily for seniors with chronic conditions like hypertension, COPD, CHF, and stroke.

product.name: Health Tracking Kit
product.description: A kit containing devices such as a blood pressure monitor, pulse oximeter, and scale to help patients track vital signs at home.

product.name: Physician Review and Same-Day Follow-Up
product.description: Daily review of patient health data by physicians with same-day outreach if any health concerns are identified.

product.name: Patient Health Data Portal
product.description: An online platform where patients and physicians can view and manage health data and communicate about care.
